import java.io.*;

    static class FastIO {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int bufferPointer, bytesRead;

        public FastIO(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public String readLine() throws IOException {
            byte[] lineBuffer = new byte[256];
            int count = 0;
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) != -1) {
                if (c == '\n') {
                    if (count > 0) break;
                    continue;
                }
                if (c == '\r') continue;
                lineBuffer[count++] = (byte) c;
            }
            if (count == 0) return null;
            return new String(lineBuffer, 0, count, "ASCII");
        }

        public int read() throws IOException {
            if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) {
                bytesRead = stream.read(buffer);
                bufferPointer = 0;
                if (bytesRead <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[bufferPointer++];
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            long num = 0;
            int c;
            do {
                c = read();
            } while (c <= ' ');
            boolean negative = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                negative = true;
                c = read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                num = num * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return negative ? -num : num;
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return (int) nextLong();
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int c;
            do {
                c = read();
            } while (c <= ' ');
            while (c > ' ') {
                sb.append((char) c);
                c = read();
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }

    static class TreeNode {
        int key;
        int value;
        TreeNode left;
        TreeNode right;
        TreeNode parent;
        int height;
        int numLeft;
        int numTotal;

        TreeNode(int k, int v) {
            key = k;
            value = v;
            height = 1;
            numLeft = 1;
            numTotal = 1;
        }
    }

    static class AvlTree {
        private TreeNode tree;

        public void add(int k, int v) {
            if (tree == null) {
                tree = new TreeNode(k, v);
                return;
            }
            TreeNode node = _add(k, v);
            if (node != null) {
                _rebalance(node);
            }
        }

        private TreeNode _add(int k, int v) {
            TreeNode node = tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (k < node.key) {
                    if (node.left != null) {
                        node = node.left;
                    } else {
                        node.left = new TreeNode(k, v);
                        node.left.parent = node;
                        return node.left;
                    }
                } else if (node.key < k) {
                    if (node.right != null) {
                        node = node.right;
                    } else {
                        node.right = new TreeNode(k, v);
                        node.right.parent = node;
                        return node.right;
                    }
                } else {
                    node.value = v;
                    return null;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static int getHeight(TreeNode x) {
            return x != null ? x.height : 0;
        }

        private static int getNumTotal(TreeNode x) {
            return x != null ? x.numTotal : 0;
        }

        private void _rebalance(TreeNode node) {
            TreeNode n = node;
            while (n != null) {
                int lh = getHeight(n.left);
                int rh = getHeight(n.right);
                n.height = Math.max(lh, rh) + 1;
                int balanceFactor = lh - rh;
                n.numTotal = 1 + getNumTotal(n.left) + getNumTotal(n.right);
                n.numLeft = 1 + getNumTotal(n.left);

                if (balanceFactor > 1) {
                    if (getHeight(n.left.left) < getHeight(n.left.right)) {
                        _rotateLeft(n.left);
                    }
                    _rotateRight(n);
                } else if (balanceFactor < -1) {
                    if (getHeight(n.right.right) < getHeight(n.right.left)) {
                        _rotateRight(n.right);
                    }
                    _rotateLeft(n);
                } else {
                    n = n.parent;
                }
            }
        }

        private void _removeOne(TreeNode node) {
            TreeNode replacement = node.left != null ? node.left : node.right;
            if (node.parent != null) {
                if (isLeft(node)) {
                    node.parent.left = replacement;
                } else {
                    node.parent.right = replacement;
                }
                if (replacement != null) {
                    replacement.parent = node.parent;
                }
                node.parent = null;
            } else {
                tree = replacement;
                if (replacement != null) {
                    replacement.parent = null;
                }
            }
            node.left = null;
            node.right = null;
            node.parent = null;
            if (replacement != null) {
                _rebalance(replacement);
            }
        }

        private void _removeLeaf(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent != null) {
                if (isLeft(node)) {
                    node.parent.left = null;
                } else {
                    node.parent.right = null;
                }
                _rebalance(node.parent);
            } else {
                tree = null;
            }
            node.parent = null;
            node.left = null;
            node.right = null;
        }

        public void remove(int k) {
            TreeNode node = _getNode(k);
            if (node == null) return;
            if (isLeaf(node)) {
                _removeLeaf(node);
                return;
            }
            if (node.left != null && node.right != null) {
                TreeNode nxt = _getNext(node);
                node.key = nxt.key;
                node.value = nxt.value;
                if (isLeaf(nxt)) {
                    _removeLeaf(nxt);
                } else {
                    _removeOne(nxt);
                }
                _rebalance(node);
            } else {
                _removeOne(node);
            }
        }

        public Integer get(int k) {
            TreeNode node = _getNode(k);
            return node != null ? node.value : -1;
        }

        private TreeNode _getNode(int k) {
            if (tree == null) return null;
            TreeNode node = tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (k < node.key) {
                    node = node.left;
                } else if (node.key < k) {
                    node = node.right;
                } else {
                    return node;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        public int[] getAt(int pos) {
            int x = pos + 1;
            TreeNode node = tree;
            while (node != null) {
                if (x < node.numLeft) {
                    node = node.left;
                } else if (node.numLeft < x) {
                    x -= node.numLeft;
                    node = node.right;
                } else {
                    return new int[]{node.key, node.value};
                }
            }
            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Out of range");
        }

        private static boolean isLeft(TreeNode node) {
            return node.parent != null && node.parent.left == node;
        }

        private static boolean isLeaf(TreeNode node) {
            return node.left == null && node.right == null;
        }

        private void _rotateRight(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent == null) {
                tree = node.left;
                node.left.parent = null;
            } else if (isLeft(node)) {
                node.parent.left = node.left;
                node.left.parent = node.parent;
            } else {
                node.parent.right = node.left;
                node.left.parent = node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode bk = node.left.right;
            node.left.right = node;
            node.parent = node.left;
            node.left = bk;
            if (bk != null) {
                bk.parent = node;
            }
            node.height = Math.max(getHeight(node.left), getHeight(node.right)) + 1;
            node.numTotal = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left) + getNumTotal(node.right);
            node.numLeft = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left);
        }

        private void _rotateLeft(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.parent == null) {
                tree = node.right;
                node.right.parent = null;
            } else if (isLeft(node)) {
                node.parent.left = node.right;
                node.right.parent = node.parent;
            } else {
                node.parent.right = node.right;
                node.right.parent = node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode bk = node.right.left;
            node.right.left = node;
            node.parent = node.right;
            node.right = bk;
            if (bk != null) {
                bk.parent = node;
            }
            node.height = Math.max(getHeight(node.left), getHeight(node.right)) + 1;
            node.numTotal = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left) + getNumTotal(node.right);
            node.numLeft = 1 + getNumTotal(node.left);
        }

        private static TreeNode _getNext(TreeNode node) {
            if (node.right == null) {
                return node.parent;
            }
            TreeNode n = node.right;
            while (n.left != null) {
                n = n.left;
            }
            return n;
        }
    }

    static class SegmentTree1 {
        private int[] data;
        private int defaultVal;
        private int len;
        private int size;
        private java.util.function.IntBinaryOperator func;

        public SegmentTree1(int[] data, int defaultVal, java.util.function.IntBinaryOperator func) {
            this.defaultVal = defaultVal;
            this.func = func;
            this.len = data.length;
            this.size = 1 << (Integer.highestOneBit(len) == 0 ? 0 : Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(Integer.highestOneBit(len)) + (len > Integer.highestOneBit(len) ? 1 : 0));
            this.data = new int[2 * size];
            Arrays.fill(this.data, defaultVal);
            System.arraycopy(data, 0, this.data, size, len);
            for (int i = size - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
                this.data[i] = func.applyAsInt(data[i << 1], data[(i << 1) | 1]);
            }
        }

        public int query(int start, int stop) {
            if (start == stop) return data[start + size];
            stop++;
            start += size;
            stop += size;
            int res = defaultVal;
            while (start < stop) {
                if ((start & 1) == 1) {
                    res = func.applyAsInt(res, data[start]);
                    start++;
                }
                if ((stop & 1) == 1) {
                    stop--;
                    res = func.applyAsInt(res, data[stop]);
                }
                start >>= 1;
                stop >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static class Factorial {
        private int MOD;
        private List<Long> factorials;
        private List<Long> invModulos;
        private List<Long> invFactorial;

        public Factorial(int MOD) {
            this.MOD = MOD;
            this.factorials = new ArrayList<>();
            this.invModulos = new ArrayList<>();
            this.invFactorial = new ArrayList<>();
            factorials.add(1L);
            factorials.add(1L);
            invModulos.add(0L);
            invModulos.add(1L);
            invFactorial.add(1L);
            invFactorial.add(1L);
        }

        public long calc(int n) {
            if (n < 0) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate n!");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            if (n < factorials.size()) return factorials.get(n);
            for (int i = factorials.size(); i <= n; i++) {
                factorials.add(factorials.get(i - 1) * i % MOD);
            }
            return factorials.get(n);
        }

        public long inv(int n) {
            if (n < 0) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate n^(-1)");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            int p = MOD;
            int pi = n % p;
            if (pi < invModulos.size()) return invModulos.get(pi);
            for (int i = invModulos.size(); i < Math.min(p, n + 1); i++) {
                long next = -invModulos.get(p % i) * (p / i) % p;
                if (next < 0) next += p;
                invModulos.add(next);
            }
            return invModulos.get(pi);
        }

        public long invFactorial(int n) {
            if (n < 0) {
                System.out.println("Invalid argument to calculate (n^(-1))!");
                System.out.println("n must be non-negative value. But the argument was " + n);
                System.exit(0);
            }
            if (n < invFactorial.size()) return invFactorial.get(n);
            inv(n);
            for (int i = invFactorial.size(); i <= n; i++) {
                invFactorial.add(invFactorial.get(i - 1) * invModulos.get(i % p) % p);
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }
    }

    static class Combination {
        private int MOD;
        private Factorial factorial;

        public Combination(int MOD) {
            this.MOD = MOD;
            this.factorial = new Factorial(MOD);
        }

        public long ncr(int n, int k) {
            if (k < 0 || n < k) return 0;
            k = Math.min(k, n - k);
            return factorial.calc(n) * factorial.invFactorial(Math.max(n - k, k)) % MOD * factorial.invFactorial(Math.min(k, n - k)) % MOD;
        }
    }

    static long powm(long a, long n, long m) {
        if (a == 1 || n == 0) return 1;
        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            long s = powm(a, n / 2, m);
            return s * s % m;
        } else {
            return a * powm(a, n - 1, m) % m;
        }
    }

    static int binarySearchCount(int[] arr, int n, int key) {
        int left = 0;
        int right = n - 1;
        int count = 0;
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (right + left) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] <= key) {
                count = mid + 1;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastIO io = new FastIO(System.in);
        int n = io.nextInt();
        int k = io.nextInt();
        int[] l = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            l[i] = io.nextInt() % k;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(l[0]);
            return;
        }
        int[] l1 = new int[n / 2];
        int[] l2 = new int[n - n / 2];
        System.arraycopy(l, 0, l1, 0, n / 2);
        System.arraycopy(l, n / 2, l2, 0, n - n / 2);
        Set<Integer> s = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> s1 = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> s2 = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            s2.clear();
            for (int j : s) {
                s2.add((j + l1[i]) % k);
            }
            s.add(l1[i]);
            s.addAll(s2);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n - n / 2; i++) {
            s2.clear();
            for (int j : s1) {
                s2.add((j + l2[i]) % k);
            }
            s1.add(l2[i]);
            s1.addAll(s2);
        }
        List<Integer> listS = new ArrayList<>(s);
        List<Integer> listS1 = new ArrayList<>(s1);
        Collections.sort(listS);
        Collections.sort(listS1);
        int ans = Math.max(listS.isEmpty() ? 0 : listS.get(listS.size() - 1), listS1.isEmpty() ? 0 : listS1.get(listS1.size() - 1));
        for (int i = 0; i < listS.size(); i++) {
            int t = k - 1 - listS.get(i);
            int ind = binarySearchCount(listS1.toArray(new int[0]), listS1.size(), t);
            if (ind > 0) {
                int r = listS1.get(ind - 1);
                int rt = listS1.get(listS1.size() - 1);
                ans = Math.max(Math.max((r + listS.get(i)) % k, (listS.get(i) + rt) % k), ans);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
